cases.zh: 统计2026年8月各地区的实付销售额，按销售额从高到低排列
cases.en: Show total paid sales by region for August 2026, ordered by sales from highest to lowest.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region AS 地区, SUM(paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

cases.zh: 统计2026年8月各客户等级的实付销售额
cases.en: Show total paid sales by customer tier for August 2026.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_level AS 客户等级, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level

cases.zh: 查询2026年8月实付销售额最高的5个产品及其销售额
cases.en: Show the top 5 products by paid sales in August 2026 and their paid sales amounts.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS 产品, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders_current o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.zh: 统计各会员等级的用户数量
cases.gold_sql: SELECT member_level,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) n FROM user_memberships GROUP BY member_level

cases.zh: 统计各支付方式成功支付的金额总和
cases.en: Show the total successful payment amount by payment method.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method,SUM(payment_amount) amount FROM payments WHERE payment_status='success' GROUP BY payment_method

cases.zh: 统计已完成退款中各退款原因的退款金额总和
cases.en: Show the total completed refund amount by refund reason.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT refund_reason,SUM(refund_amount) amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status='completed' GROUP BY refund_reason

cases.zh: 查询各仓库可用库存低于安全库存的SKU数量
cases.en: Count SKUs whose available inventory is below safety stock by warehouse name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name,COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) n FROM sku_inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id WHERE i.available_qty<i.safety_stock GROUP BY w.warehouse_name

cases.en: Find the best-performing customers in August 2026.
